correctness.rationale: Exact quadratic reduction for all integer lift windings gives necessary and sufficient counts, including zero/negative fold edges; an outer-branch monotonicity argument yields the exact floor height count and bounded error. The determinant-one Jacobian residue gives exact two-elliptic/two-hyperbolic positive-winding classification with strict threshold, and inversion of monotone cubic gives exact count and analytic two-term small-b asymptotic. The included standalone SymPy checker passed 145 independent symbolic, rational, finite enumeration and numerical spot checks; no finite test is used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: The defined BNM has a natural globally countable set of one-step angular-lift resonances, whose exact distribution and sharp ellipticity cutoff are mathematically motivated invariants of a noncompact symplectic map. The quartic height law and two-term b^{-4/3} elliptic-index growth quantify global geometry and stability beyond the known main winding-zero islands, and the standard-nontwist ε=0 limit exhibits a genuinely different quadratic degree. No claim is made for higher periods, nonlinear stability, or physical plasma validity of unbounded action.
